# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_EDGE_CHECK

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We verify that the baseline engine (as reflected in the leaderboard's base performance) maintains the J anchor day P&Ls (no regression on 4/29 and 5/04 wins) and compute its edge_capture and wide_pnl over the period 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 via a Stage-1 backtest using the autoresearch grinder harness.

## Mechanism

The Stage-1 backtest was executed via the autoresearch grinder harness (standard OP-22 protocol) using the baseline engine configuration (no candidate modifications). The harness processed 5-minute SPY bars from 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18, applied the engine's entry/exit logic, and aggregated P&L per trade. J anchor day P&Ls were extracted from the trade log and compared to the source-of-truth values. Edge_capture was calculated per OP-16: sum(engine P&L on J winner days) minus sum(max(0, engine loss on J loser days)). Wide_pnl is the total P&L over the entire period.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The baseline engine assumes a $25K+ account for full position sizing (qty=28 corresponds to ~10% risk per trade at $1.00 entry premium). At $1K paper, realized P&L scales to ~14% of headline.
2. **Sample bias:** The sample spans 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (16 months, ~345 trading days). Selection is deterministic (all bars in range). Overfit risk is mitigated by OP-16 anchor gating and walk-forward validation elsewhere; this Stage-1 run is in-sample only.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this is a Stage-1 in-sample run; OOS validation pending).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (this analysis uses the BS simulator; real OPRA fill validation not performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potentially a large loser day if engine takes adverse structure (e.g., 5/07 call loser). Max drawdown: unknown without full equity curve. Blow-up scenario: repeated losses on loser days combined with missed winners could drive edge_capture below 771.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top5_pct of wide_pnl.
